title: wicked coverage report (v1.0.0)
description: The resolved-or-flagged coverage ledger — part of the @wicked/domain-model-schema bundle. Formalizes anti-legacy's coverage-report.json (the coverage.py output). Every behavior-bearing estate SymbolId is either RESOLVED (a rule annotation at/above the confidence threshold) or RISK-flagged (on the HITL research queue) — never bare/unaccounted. `coverage` = (resolved + risk_flagged) / behavior_bearing, in [0,1], rounded to 4 dp, is the ACCOUNTED ledger. The minimum (bundle 1.3.0, wicked-core#1233) counts REAL requirements only: floor(resolved * 100 / behavior_bearing) against the configured minimum; risk-flagged placeholders never count, and behavior_bearing is product code only (not_product counts what is left out). The report doubles as a gate predicate: `wicked-core coverage --min-coverage-pct` exits non-zero below the minimum. Deterministic: unaccounted_nodes and per_app are sorted by SymbolId / app name.

unaccountedNode.description: A behavior-bearing node that reached neither RESOLVED nor RISK — the coverage hole. References the estate SymbolId; carries no copy of the node's source.

total.description: Total nodes in the graph (all kinds).

behavior_bearing.description: The coverage denominator — behavior-bearing nodes only (config-driven via coverage.behavior_kinds, never hardcoded).

resolved.description: Behavior-bearing nodes RESOLVED (rule annotation at/above resolve_threshold).

risk_flagged.description: Behavior-bearing nodes RISK-flagged (on the HITL queue, incl. below-threshold 'resolved').

unaccounted.description: Behavior-bearing nodes that are still bare (the coverage hole). MUST be 0 for coverage == 1.0.

coverage.description: (resolved + risk_flagged) / behavior_bearing, 4 dp: the ACCOUNTED ledger, not the gate. Since bundle 1.3.0 (wicked-core#1233) the minimum counts real requirements only: floor(resolved * 100 / behavior_bearing) against the configured minimum, so a fully accounted report of mostly placeholders fails it. Vacuously 1.0 when there are no behavior-bearing nodes.

mean_confidence.description: Mean confidence across RESOLVED nodes carrying a numeric confidence, 4 dp (resolved-only, per coverage.py).

resolve_threshold.description: Confidence threshold at/above which a rule annotation counts as RESOLVED (default 0.75).

per_app.description: Per-app breakdown, sorted by app name.

unaccounted_nodes.description: The bare behavior-bearing nodes, sorted by SymbolId. Empty iff coverage == 1.0.

not_product.description: Behaviour-kind nodes left OUT of behavior_bearing because their file is not product code (a test, data, manifest or document file). Optional: absent on reports written before bundle 1.3.0.

placeholder_nodes.description: The risk-flagged placeholders (accounted, not real requirements), sorted by SymbolId: what the next extraction page may revisit. Absent when there are none.

requirement_reuse.description: Concentration of `requirement` strings across the nodes claiming them. Reported, never gated: coverage==1.0 says every behavior-bearing node is accounted for, not that the accounting means anything. See wicked-core#131 — 46 distinct strings were written as the requirement of 34,897 nodes and every gate passed. ABSENT when no node carries a requirement, so a present object is always fully populated.

max_nodes_per_requirement.description: Nodes sharing the single most-reused `requirement` string.

most_reused_requirement.description: That string, truncated to 120 characters INCLUDING a trailing ellipsis.
